book.title: Roma Roma Ekalesia veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa

content: Vine Zaḡoḡa Hegote Radiuꞌeteꞌe Ḡaboneḡa
Eꞌanoꞌo izidi iniu Iesu Keriso teite tiburaroteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa veꞌoḡa rae mene raꞌohe.
Mazaḡa Keriso Iesu uꞌano, ḡabone rifiꞌeteꞌe Vineḡa Zaḡoḡa goro ḡoeꞌaniꞌa haḡai sauꞌa zu rune goro ḡoeꞌanonoꞌo zae bohaze buziro.

Emeḡeꞌa ahiri urao haḡai sauꞌa haḡaeꞌe ꞌahine, Mose goro ḡoeꞌaniꞌa zoreradu emeḡe ḡabofogaꞌe mene idararo, rehano Badiꞌaꞌa ḡabofiro. Aniꞌa ane Ubugaꞌe haḡai sauꞌa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ahiri teige, vazeo tuḡuniro. Ebu emeḡe haḡai sauꞌa mae vaḡinoga veize, haḡaife sauꞌa ane rana teadu ahiriḡano aduga haro.
Aꞌe, emeꞌa ahiri ura mene hegotadu Vine Zaḡoḡa hegote radifine, ebu Mose goro ḡoeꞌano haḡaoꞌi rae raꞌeteꞌe haḡaiḡa duduḡa niduꞌa emeḡeꞌa haḡae hunifine raꞌohe.
Iniu ahiri ura hegote radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe ahiri ura zamareꞌohe. U iniu Vine Zaḡoḡa hegote radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Vine Zaḡoḡa ura zamareꞌohe.
Ahiri ura mone zamaroneḡaꞌe rune, rehano Vine Zaḡoḡa mone zamaroneḡaꞌe ḡabone zu zama roḡeḡa.
Ahiri ura mone zamaroneḡaniꞌa Badiꞌa agirohauꞌohe. Aꞌe Badiꞌa goro ḡoeꞌa mene hegoteꞌohe ebu hegotoga zuni mene idaḡa.
Ahiri urao radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Badiꞌa matuꞌohanoga mene idaḡa.
Rehano Badiꞌa Vineꞌa zae zamao radiuꞌetene, zaꞌe ahiri ura mene hegote radiuꞌohe, rehano Vine Zaḡoḡa ura hegote radiuꞌohe. Iniu mazao Keriso Vine oꞌoꞌa reine, aniꞌe mene Keriso mone vazeḡa raꞌohe.
Rehano Kerisoꞌa zae zamao radiune, zae ahiriꞌe haḡai sauꞌa uꞌano rudau huneꞌohe, rehano zaꞌe Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa raꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, zae vineꞌe ḡabodeꞌohe.

Badiꞌaꞌa rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano Iesu ḡaboniro. Zae zamao Badiꞌa Vineꞌa radiune, rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano Keriso ḡaboniroteꞌe Badiꞌaḡaniꞌa zae zuni ḡaboziꞌuma. Badiꞌa Vineꞌe zae zamao radiuꞌe ꞌahine, ahirizeꞌa rudatiteꞌe zuni ḡaboziꞌuma.
Eꞌanoꞌo, nego nabudi, emeꞌa haḡae huniteꞌe haḡaiḡaꞌe mene ahiri mone haḡaiḡa. Emeꞌe ahiri ura mene hegote radiu huniꞌuma.
Mazaḡa zaeꞌa ahiri ura hegote radiune rudaꞌuma, rehano Vine Zaḡoḡa hegotadu ahirio haḡai sauꞌa mae modine ḡabodiꞌuma.
Iniu Badiꞌa Vineꞌa ibitoziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Badiꞌa ubugaubuga.
Zaꞌe Badiꞌa Vine meiro. Badiꞌa Vineꞌe zaeꞌa bare rihau radiuꞌeteꞌe tuḡure azaḡano mene ohozeꞌohe. Zaeꞌa meiroteꞌe Vigaꞌe za Badiꞌa ubugaubugano mae ohozadu Vine eꞌe uꞌano emeꞌa Badiꞌa mazao, “Mama,
eḡe Mama,” rae huneꞌohe.
Vine Zaḡoḡaꞌe aneꞌa bare emeḡe vine teite emeꞌe Badiꞌa ubugaubuga rae fureneꞌohe.

Emeꞌe Badiꞌa ubugaubuga ꞌahine, emeḡe zuni Badiꞌa emeḡe Mama mazaonoꞌo toheḡa meiteꞌe ubugaubuga raꞌohe. Emeꞌe Keriso teite nife ḡihiꞌaḡa rouga veize, ani teite aduga zuni hidine, emeꞌe Badiꞌa emeḡe Mama toheḡa meiteꞌe ubugaubuga rae reꞌuma, ebu Keriso teite eꞌe meiteꞌe ubugaubuga rae reꞌuma.
Zama mone Meiteꞌe Ḡihiꞌaḡa

Emeꞌa izidi hideꞌeteꞌe adugaḡaꞌe zama mone Badiꞌaꞌa emeḡe mazao fureniteꞌe ḡihiꞌaḡa teite mene idaḡa. Izidi emeḡe adugaꞌe zama mone emeꞌa hiditeꞌe ḡihiꞌaḡa teite idanine, eḡe zamarone, aꞌe huga oꞌoꞌa.
Badiꞌaꞌa haḡairoteꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌaꞌe Badiꞌa ubugaubuganiꞌa fureranoga guhine huneꞌohe.
Badiꞌaꞌa haḡairoteꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌaꞌe huga oꞌoꞌa reiro. Aꞌe mene zeḡe urao, rehano Badiꞌaꞌa ꞌouge haḡairo. Rehano manoḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa fureraꞌuma rae mae ḡihineꞌenaꞌa guhineꞌohe.

Badiꞌaꞌa haḡairoteꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌaꞌe hube hune ruhuru dauḡeꞌohe. Rehano Badiꞌaꞌa ruhuratiteꞌe ḡauḡanonoꞌo ze bohaze buzadu, ane ubugaubugaꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune rae raꞌeteꞌe teige, zeḡe zuni ḡihiꞌa hune rae reiteꞌe madaḡa zeꞌa guhineꞌohe.
Eme edeḡa, Badiꞌaꞌa haḡairoteꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌaꞌe tiburu rudurudeꞌenaꞌa, ene fureneꞌeteꞌe teige gigizeꞌohe, onao izidi madaḡa.

Mene Badiꞌaꞌa haḡairoteꞌe ḡauḡa daꞌo, rehano emeḡe zuni rudurudeꞌohe. Eme Badiꞌa ḡahunone ibiꞌa meiro, aꞌe Vine Zaḡoḡa. Eme zuni Badiꞌa ubugaubuga rae mae ḡihifoga ebu haḡai sauꞌanonoꞌo ahirife bohafe bufoga mae ḡihinadu guhineꞌenaꞌa, zamafeo uhureꞌohe.
Emeꞌa ꞌouge mae ḡihineꞌenaꞌa guhineꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, ḡabone hidiro. Emeꞌa rahao horoneꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡaꞌe mene guhineꞌohe. Vazeni ꞌahoga nagini horoneꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa mene guhineꞌohe!
Rehano emeꞌa mene horoneꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa mae ḡihinadu guhinine, zamafe obone giganeꞌenaꞌa, guhiniꞌuma.

Eꞌe teige, eme zorereꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa danafeꞌohe. Emeꞌa nagini veize Badiꞌa mazao kuraꞌumaꞌe aḡuꞌa rehano, Vine Zaḡoḡa aneꞌa bare ufeta zamaḡa aradu ḡoereo rouga zuni mene idaḡa raꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano uhureꞌohe zu emeḡe veize kurauꞌohe.
Ebu zamafe udaheꞌeteꞌe Badiꞌaḡaꞌe Vine Zaḡoḡa zamaroneḡa edeḡa, mazaḡa Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa Badiꞌa ura idunaḡano Badiꞌa mone azaḡa veize kurauꞌohe.
Eme edeḡa, iniuꞌa Badiꞌa zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa, Badiꞌa urao huziroteꞌe azaḡa veize Badiꞌaꞌa gau niduꞌa tibunadu manoḡa haḡaeꞌohe.
Badiꞌaꞌe ibite ederiroteꞌe azaḡaꞌe ane Ubuga iraḡa rae rouga veize ibite ohotiro. ꞌOugadu ane Ubugaꞌe negoḡa nabuga ḡehaḡa boꞌaḡano Ubuga ibiꞌa reiro.
Ebu Badiꞌaꞌa ibite ohotiroteꞌe azaḡa huziro, ebu huziroteꞌe azaḡaꞌe ane ubumao duduḡa rae reiro, ebu duduḡa rae reiroteꞌe azaḡa niꞌe mae ḡihiniro.
Badiꞌa Zamarone ꞌUeꞌeteꞌe Ḡauḡaꞌe Oꞌoꞌa
Tena eꞌeguḡa moneo eme nagini reꞌuma? Badiꞌaꞌe emeḡe none reine, iniuꞌa emeḡe agirofiꞌuma?
Badiꞌaꞌa ane Ubuga mene ufeta zamare borofiro, rehano emeḡe niduꞌa veize ahetiro. Eꞌe Badiꞌaḡaniꞌa ḡau niduꞌaꞌe Ubuga teite ḡahunone radu rifiꞌuma!
Iniuꞌa Badiꞌaꞌa ohotiroteꞌe azaḡaꞌe veꞌoḡa rae roziꞌuma? Zeꞌe duduḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe Badiꞌa!
Iniuꞌa zeꞌe veꞌoḡa rae reꞌuma? Iesu Kerisoꞌe rudaro rehano, bare ḡabodiro ebu Badiꞌa edaꞌe moneo radiuꞌenaꞌa emeḡe veize kurauꞌohe.

Kerisoꞌa emeḡe zamare borofeꞌeteꞌeanoꞌo iniuꞌa rovofiꞌuma? Emeḡeꞌa sauꞌa hidine ga, aduga hidine ga, vazeꞌa sausaufine ga, zahara madaḡa hidine ga, ḡaufe oꞌoꞌa reine ga, nariga ꞌomateꞌeteꞌe madaḡa hidine ga, vazeꞌa uḡufihi reine, ꞌuguḡaniꞌa Kerisoꞌa emeḡe zamare borofeꞌeteꞌeanoꞌo rovofiꞌumahe?
Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro,

content.text: “Zuhiꞌa Boro veize eme mada niduꞌa rune hideꞌohe.
Vazeꞌa matiteꞌe mamoeḡa teige, ze emeḡe uḡufihi reiro.”

content: Rehano emeḡe zamare borofiroteꞌe vazeḡa, Keriso uꞌano, emeꞌe aduga ꞌuguḡa niduꞌa raharahane huneꞌohe.
E hube hune edeḡa. Rune ga, ḡabone ga, tuḡure viga niduꞌa ga, vine sauꞌa niduꞌa
ga, izidi fureruꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa ga, zama moneo fureratiteꞌe ḡauḡa ga, inara nunu ga,
hitaga habaꞌa ga, ꞌuꞌuḡa habaꞌa, ga Badiꞌaꞌa haḡairoteꞌe ḡauḡani ꞌahoga zuni emeḡe Zuhiꞌa Boro Keriso Iesu uꞌano Badiꞌaꞌa eme zamare borofeꞌeteꞌeanoꞌo rovofogaꞌe mene idaḡa.
